title: libcuflynx variable mapping, JSON form (<prefix>_variable_mapping.csv)
description: The LaTeX symbol of each variable of a model, for the methods text (cuflynx-methods-latex). The file is a CSV with a header row, UTF-8 (a BOM is accepted), read by libcuflynx.reporting.variable_mapping.read_variable_mapping, which converts it to this document (variable_mapping_document): each non-blank row becomes one entry of variables, its columns the entry's keys, its values stripped of surrounding whitespace. The columns variable_name and latex are required, kind, component and units are libcuflynx's, and any other column (such as bondgraph, the bond graph name a CellDL editor or bgtool writes) is kept as it is: refreshing the file (cuflynx-variable-mapping) rewrites libcuflynx's columns from the model and leaves the others. What JSON Schema cannot check, the reader does: the header names variable_name and latex, and a variable_name is not in the file twice.

variables.description: Required. One entry per variable, in the file's order.

variable_name.description: Required. The variable's canonical name, component/variable, the component without a trailing _module (e.g. mod_A/x, parameters/p_mod_A, environment/time): the names obs_data operands and params_for_id use.

latex.description: Required. The symbol, LaTeX without $ (e.g. x_{\mathrm{A}}). Empty: the default rule's symbol (latex_names.symbol). A refresh keeps it.

kind.description: What the variable is: time, state, parameter (in a parameters component), constant (a literal in a module) or algebraic; empty when not known, filled in from the model by a refresh.

component.description: The variable's component in the model, as named there (e.g. mod_A_module).

units.description: Its units, as Myokit writes them without brackets (dimensionless for 1); empty for none.

additionalProperties.description: Another column, kept as it is (e.g. bondgraph: the bond graph name of the variable).
